{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to incorrect PSBT analysis for MuSig transactions; suggested updating sigdata directly inside SignMuSig2 rather than adding an output parameter"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3824206065",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "PSBT analysis is incorrect for transactions involving a musig",
      "quote": "This results in the analysis still being incorrect for transactions involving a musig.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the patch to distinguish MuSig aggregate matches and added a regression check",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3824725990"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3824725990",
      "status_by_quote": "I updated the patch to distinguish when `SignMuSig2()` actually matched a MuSig2 aggregate, and only add `missing_sigs` for the non-MuSig case."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4169958308",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid adding an output parameter by having SignMuSig2 update sigdata directly",
      "quote": "Adding an output parameter here is entirely unnecessary. `SignMuSig2` has access to `sigdata`, it can update the fields itself if no signature was made.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],

    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address achow101's suggestion to avoid the output parameter and update sigdata directly",
      "id": "rc:4169958308"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added achow101's review comment rc:4169958308 suggesting SignMuSig2 update sigdata directly instead of using an output parameter. PR is waiting on the author."
}
